reviews.text: Jason Herrin and his team helped us after the big hail storm.  Thank you so much for the beautiful new roof that you put on our home!
reviews.author: Kim Thedford

reviews.text: Had Jason Herrin, at Game Time Construction, come out and quote some major storm damage to our home. One of the quickest and easiest processes I’ve ever been involved with. Jason met with the insurance adjuster and had everything handled and ready in less than a day. Had a complete roof replacement and damaged windows replaced. Would absolutely use these guys again if I needed to.
reviews.author: Keith Ralston

reviews.text:
My next-door neighbor hired these guys to replace her roof. They started at 6 am before sunrise. Can't fault them for that because of the heat, but by the time I was dressed and outside, they had stripped most of the old roof off and hadn't put any tarps down to catch the debris. Then made multiple sweeps with a leaf blower to blow the old shingles, tacks and nails into my yard.  Something to think about before hiring them. Do you want to hire a company that prints glossy brochures and then trashes the neighbor's homes?

I can now say the guys doing the gutter replacement are just as bad. I went out several times and asked them not to cut through my yard and toss their trash in it to no avail. They tore the old gutters down and tossed the hardware that held them up into my flower beds. The mangled gutters were left on my lawn.

Today the painters showed up at the job site at 11 AM and spent the first 45 minutes smoking cigarettes (discarding the butts on my lawn) and eating fast food (wrappers left on the street). After about 90 minutes they left but returned in about an hour. I asked them a couple of times during the day to stay off of my property, but then they came back after 5PM and once again are dragging ladlers and power washers across my lawn. I stopped my supper and went out again to tell them to get off my grass. I would like to point out that they also blocked another neighbor's driveway parking a truck and trailer.
reviews.author: Sue Kovach

reviews.text:
Let me start by saying I do recommend this company.
I’m very happy with the roof and the way it looks, but I was very disappointed in the cleanup crew. Even though they had a dumpster, they still filled up my garbage cans with some of their trash, they left things in my backyard, which my dogs got a hold of and chewed up. My son, and I had to walk around and pick up little pieces of tar paper in the yard and they left nails laying on top of my air conditioning unit. Because we are having the first rain since I got the roof, I went into the attic to make sure there was no leaks and everything looks Bone dry but I will say they left a big gap that rain can and will blow in the first time the wind blows really hard that direction and it’s raining.
They said they will come back and fix it and I’m sure they will because again I do recommend this company. You just really have to stay on the crew about their trash. I personally am a perfectionist a former marine with OCD so I would give them 95% out of 100.
reviews.author: Johnny

reviews.text: Great company to work with!  Fast and very reliable! The staff is fantastic, they listen to all concerns! We were so happy we had them fix our roof, fence and sun screens.
reviews.author: Donald Smith

reviews.text: We had our roof replaced after hail damage. Jason and Alexandria were very professional. The estimate we received was fair and accurate. We wouldn’t hesitate to use Gametime again in the future.
reviews.author: Mary Hurley

reviews.text: I was only wanting an estimate when I initially set up my appointment but after speaking with Richard Powers, I understood why getting 3 estimates and sending them to my insurance company would be the worst thing I could do... I can't even express how grateful I truly am for having Richard handle my claim. He really had my back and my best interest in mind, whilst keeping me updated and in-the-loop the entire time. Thanks again Richard Powers..
reviews.author: RAP Las Cruces

reviews.text: The service is exceptional. They went above and beyond to install my roof and gutters. From dealing with the HOA, to leaving my yard clean. If I  could give more than five stars I would because they deserve it. I highly recommend this company for all your contracting needs.
reviews.author: Angelo Tate

data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic with a clear, consistent complaint pattern about post-job cleanup. The company seems competent at insurance/storm restoration work but has operational issues with debris management. Low review volume is a minor concern but not definitive of fakery.
fake_signals: Low total review volume (28 Google, 11 Yelp) for a 2-year-old company could indicate limited customer base or selective solicitation
Some 5-star reviews are generic and focus on insurance/process rather than construction quality
authentic_signals: Specific negative details about cleanup issues from multiple reviewers
Mention of specific employee names (Jason, Alexandria, Richard)
Negative review provides specific, credible scenario with neighbor's experience
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent across platforms, all in the 4.2-4.6 range. BBB rating reflects accreditation and complaint handling, not service quality.
